content: Kristo Sʋ Anɩbʋ Nkpa
Nkálɩ abɛ́blɩ́ séi? Ilehián ánɩ́ abɔ́yɔ anɩ lakpanbwɛsʋ, mɛ́nɩ Bulu awɩtɔlɛ bómoní tsɩ́a?
Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Igyi fɛ́ anɩlawú, mʋ́ sʋ lakpan ma túmi anɩsʋ. Ntogyi sʋ abɛ́trá tsiá bwɛ́ lakpan?
Brɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ bɔbɔ anɩ asú ámʋ a, anɩa Kristo Yesunyɔ anɩlɔ́bwɛ kʋlɛ. Mlɩyin mʋ́ alɩ? Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, anɩa Kristonyɔ lówu,
bopulá anɩ, tsúfɛ́ anɩa mʋnyɔ anɩlabwɛ́ kʋlɛ. Mʋ́ sʋ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ anɩ Sɩ́ Onumnyampʋ amʋ lɔ́kʋsʋ́a mʋ tsú afúlitɔ ámʋ a, alɩ kɛ́n anɩ ɛ́ abétsiá itsiá pɔpwɛtɔ nɩ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɩ́nɩá anɩa mʋnyɔ anɩlɔ́bwɛ kʋlɛ mʋ lowutɔ á, alɩ kɛ́n anɩa mʋnyɔ lɔ́bwɛ kʋlɛ mʋ kʋsʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ ɛ́ nɩ́.
Mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ brɛ́á bɛda Yesu mántá oyikpalíhɛ amʋsʋ á, mʋa anɩ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋ lówu, mɛ́nɩ anɩmɛ́ɛtrá bwɛ lakpan nkpábi.
Tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ ɔha owú á, ɔtamatráa bwɛ lakpan. Lakpan má mʋsʋ túmi.
Ɩ́nɩá anɩa mʋnyɔ anɩlawú sʋ á, anɩbʋ hógyi ánɩ́ anɩa mʋnyɔ abétsiá nkpa.
Anɩyin ánɩ́ Bulu lɔ́kʋsʋ́a Kristo tsú afúlitɔ. Ɔmɛ́ɛtrá wu ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ. Lowu ɩtráa ma mʋsʋ túmi.
Yesu lówunáa wu ɔtsáwʋlɛ, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɛ́lɛ lakpan ɩnʋ. Támɛ ɩ́nɩá otsie nkpa á, otsie ha Bulu.
Mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩkɩ mlɩ ɩwɩ ánɩ́ mlɩlawú há lakpan, amlɩlɛ mlɩ ɩwɩ lɛ mʋ́ túmi asɩ. Mlɩtsia nkpa ha Bulu, tsúfɛ́ mlɩa Kristo Yesunyɔ mlɩlabwɛ́ kʋlɛ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mlɩmáha lakpan igyi mlɩ nyankpʋsa-oyí ánfɩ ibówu ánfɩsʋ, mɛ́nɩ ɩmɛ́ɛha ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ igyi mlɩsʋ, amlɩbwɛ tɔ́á ideklé.
Mlɩmápʋ mlɩ nyankpʋsa-oyí ɩwɩ atɔ́ há lalahɛbwɛ. Mboún mlɩpʋ mlɩ ɩwɩ fɛ́ɛ́ ha Bulu, fɛ́ ahá ánɩ́ alakʋ́sʋ́a amʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ ba nkpatɔ, ɔpʋ mlɩ bwɛ tɔ́á ɩda ɔkpa.
Ɩma alɛá lakpan ɔbɛ́trá gyi mlɩsʋ, tsúfɛ́ séi mlɩtráa mlɩmá Mose Mbla ámʋ asɩ. Bulu awɩtɔlɛ asɩ mboún mlɩbʋ.
Yilébwɛ Nkpábi Anɩgyí
Ɩ́nɩ ɔma a, amansʋ abɛ́blɩ́? Ɩbʋ alɛ́á abɛ́trá bwɛ lakpan séi ánfɩ ánɩmá mbla ámʋ asɩ, anɩbʋ Bulu awɩtɔlɛ mboún asɩ? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!

Mlɩméyín ánɩ́ nɩ́ mlɛba ɩwɩasɩ há tɔkʋ, mlɩdɛ́ mʋ́ apɛ́ bwɛ, mlɩdɛ́ mʋ́ súm fɛ́ mlɩ wíe a, mlɩlabwɛ́ mʋ́ nkpábi? Nɩ́ mlɛba ɩwɩasɩ há lakpan á, mʋ́mʋ́ mlówu, támɛ nɩ́ mlɛba ɩwɩasɩ há Bulu á, mlégyi asʋ mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Mlɩlɔ́bwɛ nkpábi há lakpan brɛ́ kʋtɔ. Séi á, mlɩlapʋ́ mlɩ klʋn fɛ́ɛ́ hɔ atosunáhɛ́ amʋ́ʋ́ bapʋ́há mlɩ ámʋ, mlɩdɛ́ mʋ́sʋ́ gyí. Mʋ́ sʋ ndɛ Bulu ɩpán da.
Bulu lahá mlɩlagyi ɩwɩ lɛ́ lakpan ɩbɩtɔ, mlɩlabwɛ́ nkpábi há yilébwɛ.

Alɩá ɩbɔ́bwɛ mlónu asʋ́n ánfɩ asɩ, sʋ́ napʋ́ nkpábi tsiátɔ́ ndɛ mlɩ suná. Brɛ́ kʋtɔ á, mlɩlɔ́bwɛ mlɩ ɩwɩ nkpábi há hakpan mʋ́a lalahɛbwɛ. Alɩ kɛ́n ilehián ánɩ́ mlɔ́bwɛ mlɩ ɩwɩ nkpábi ha yilébwɛ, mɛ́nɩ mlɔ́fʋn yi nɩ.
Brɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩgyí nkpábi há lakpanbwɛ ámʋ a, yilébwɛ má túmi mlɩsʋ.
Labi mɔmʋ mlɩlénya tsú lakpan ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩlɔ́bwɛ, ndɛ ɩbʋ mlɩ pɛ́lɩ amʋtɔ? Mʋ́ labi gyí lowu.
Támɛ séi mʋ́ á, Bulu lahá mlɩlagyi ɩwɩ lakpanbwɛ túmi asɩ. Mlɩlamlí mʋ nkpábi. Labiá mlénya tsú mʋ́tɔ́ gyí; mlétsiá tsiátɔ́á ɩlɔfʋn yi, nyá nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá.
Tsúfɛ́ lakpanbwɛ ɩkɔká gyí lowu, támɛ Bulu atokiehɛ́ gyí nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá. Mʋ́ ɔlɔpʋgyi anɩ bʋalɛ tsʋn anɩa anɩ Wíe Kristo Yesu ɩkʋlɛbwɛsʋ nɩ́.
